name: Covered Circular Box with Decoration of Four Butterflies Surrounding a Stylized Flower on a Beaded Ground
dimensions: including cover: H. 6.2 x Diam. 11.1 cm (2 7/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；9th-early 10th century；Monochrome lead-glazed ware: molded white earthenware with lead-fluxed emerald-green glaze on the exterior and lead-fluxed clear glaze mottled with green on the interior. Probably from kilns at Luoyang or Gongxian, Henan province.
